items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Fud Livingston was leading the band and they wanted a tenor man right away... I got into the Pollack band... Fud Livingston was leading the band

ctx.x: You did mention that, but we did not go into it.
You see, when I made the Condon-McKenzie record on Okay, it was on the strength of the solo that I played there, when I got into the Pollack band - you are right, I didn't say that.

And I must say, Glenn Miller, Benny Goodman and Jimmy McPartland spoke up for me -Fud Livingston was leading the band and they wanted a tenor man right away and they were going to New York on this new job. We were then in Chicago.
